$comment: Customer-visible switches of `ui-switches/catalogue.json` that have NO guide article, each with why (gate `guide-coverage`, 21/10/2026). A switch is exempt when a customer does not USE it as a feature to ask about: it only shows or hides a piece of the page (a column, a chip, a row of the launcher), or it belongs to dsh's own settings screens. A switch for something a customer DOES — connect a domain, publish, restore, invite — needs an article in apps/tracy-web/src/guide/articles, not a row here. Adding a row to make a PR green is the failure this gate exists to prevent: write the article.
